user_story: As a user who has forgotten their login information, I want to be able to retrieve my login details using the forgotten login lookup form so that I can access my account. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The form must include input fields for 'First Name', 'Last Name', 'Address', 'City', 'State', 'Zip Code', and 'SSN'. 2. When the user fills out the form with valid information and clicks the 'Find My Login Info' button, they must be redirected to a confirmation page or remain on the same page if valid input was given. 3. If the user submits the form without filling in any fields, the URL must not change, and the page must remain on 'https://parabank.parasoft.com/parabank/lookup.htm'.
